speaker: Operator
text: Good morning and welcome to the Acme Corp second quarter 2026 earnings call.

speaker: Jane Smith
text: Thank you all for joining. Revenue for the quarter was $110 million, up from $100 million a year ago. Net income was $20 million. We are pleased with these results and expect continued momentum into the second half of the year.

speaker: Bob Lee
text: To add some detail, gross margin came in at 45%, and we are guiding full-year revenue to approximately $460 million.

speaker: Analyst One
text: Can you comment on the drivers of revenue growth this quarter?

speaker: Jane Smith
text: Sure. Growth was primarily driven by strong demand in our core enterprise segment, along with the expansion into three new regional markets.

speaker: Analyst Two
text: What are the key risks you are watching for the back half of the year?

speaker: Bob Lee
text: We are watching foreign exchange headwinds and potential softness in discretionary enterprise spending as the main risks.
